serStmt.serInfo: A line list is a working table that contains essential information about each reported case. Each row represents a case. Each column represents a variable informing on specific characteristic about that case. Variables contains the characteristics of each case such as demographic, epidemiologic, clinical and laboratory information. This line list can be used to support the collection and reporting of the minimum standard case-based data to be recorded at the health facility level on all suspected cholera cases.

verStmt.version: V0.1 : Basic raw data, obtained from data entry

sumDscr.universe: all cholera cases in Malawi from 2023 - 2024

stdyInfo.notes:
GENERAL INFORMATION: date of reporting, reporting health facility, Patient unique identifier
PATIENT INFORMATION: demographics (name, age, sex), administrative residence details (Admin 1 to Admin 4, address), date of visit to health facility
EPIDEMIOLOGICAL INFORMATION: epidemiological linkage (yes/no), vaccination status and number of doses, risk factors (water, food, travel, contact)
TREATMENT AND OUTCOME DETAILS: treatment administered (e.g., Ringers lactate, ORS, antibiotics), place of outcome (facility, community), occupation of patient, additional comments for case context
CHOLERA TESTING INFORMATION: Specimen collection details and dates, RDT results (serogroup identification), Laboratory testing (culture, PCR for serogroup and toxigenicity),Antimicrobial susceptibility testing results for multiple antibiotics (Azithromycin, Ciprofloxacin, Pefloxacin, Tetracycline, Doxycycline, Erythromycin)

fileTxt.fileCont: This dataset contains raw and derived case-based surveillance data for suspected and confirmed cholera cases reported by health facilities in Malawi. The data includes both collected variables (directly entered from the cholera case reporting form) and derived variables (processed for analysis and reporting).
